Crew stand on their boats by their layout support (boat deck:/boat roof:) or the boats block's crew, at their layout spots (which carry their boats' moves), never nudged here. boats: the boats agent's (gen/sections/canal/boats_people.json: motion, crew work, haul, tow), copied unchanged except the trackers' haul clips (walk/stand), which are the casting's. walkers: figures painted mid-stride or carrying a load, walking along their painted direction and back (walkers_why). animals: each painted animal at its map position facing hind to fore, model and load from web/public/assets/animals/animals.json (animals_why). Seats the map lacks: gen/sections/canal/seats.json, for the builder. No traffic.
